screens.screen: dm-progress (direction C, Attention first: verdict line, then tinted blocks for Blocked, In review and Done, one-line rows for the rest; desktop 540 and phone 358; digest, immediate blocked and done cards, /progress reply with caret menu, muted and unavailable rows, hostile title)

dm-progress shared states for A, B and C (/progress loading and empty, updates paused by archive and by missing thread, control failed, offline, undo toast, reconnect, count-only push line in English and Vietnamese, Vietnamese labels on the C layout)

export_sha256_method: sha256 of the lines '<sha256>  <file>' (each ending in a newline, as `sha256sum` prints them) for export_files, sorted by file name
export_transform: none: each frame HTML is self-contained (system font stack, inline SVG, no external fetch); written as read from doop via get_frame, including its one trailing newline; length in characters equals htmlBytes from get_frame (15465 for V0nBnIQ-OI, 9483 for TiPMSzRj-T)
